blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: kUSD is backed 1:1 by USDC held in the on-chain Peg Stability Module, so its redemption value inherits Circle USDC freeze and seizure exposure through the reserve asset. The kUSD token's own admin freeze surface was not independently re-read on-chain in this submission.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Per the live /api/stats endpoint kUSD reserves are 100% USDC in the PSM, so freeze exposure is inherited from the USDC reserve asset; kUSD's own token freeze surface is unreviewed in this submission.
